decisions.reason: The waterproof lined range is the firm's flagship and sits close to its core safety-footwear and materials know-how, so in-house R&D lets it interpret results and keep improving the line.

An ESD occupational shoe builds directly on the firm's established footwear and materials expertise, which makes it easy to assimilate and refine, though as a single model it is more exposed to range rationalisation.
